---
name: Skill Request
about: Request a new skill for the La-Z-Boy agent skill library
title: "[Skill Request] <skill-name>"
labels: skill-request
---

## What domain should this skill cover?
<!-- e.g., API conventions, design system, data pipeline patterns, etc. -->

## What problem does it solve?
<!-- What will agents be able to do with this skill that they can't do well now? -->

## Who would use it?
<!-- Team, role, or tool (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.) -->

## Trigger examples
<!-- What phrases or situations should cause an agent to use this skill? -->
<!-- e.g., "generate an API endpoint", "create a new component", "write a SQL query" -->

## Do you have source material?
<!-- Link to docs, guidelines, Confluence pages, Notion, etc. the skill should be based on -->

## Are you willing to build it?
- [ ] Yes, I'll build it following the org standard
- [ ] I can provide the source material but need someone else to build it
- [ ] Just requesting — someone else should build it
